item.title: Two killed, dozens injured as fresh violence rocks Assam’s Karbi Anglong
item.description: Fresh violence erupted in Assam’s trouble-hit Karbi Anglong district on Tuesday, leaving two people dead and at least 45 others injured, including 38 police personnel, after rival groups of protesters clashed in the Kheroni area, officials said.

item.title: Vande Bharat train avoids accident after auto rickshaw found on Kerala track
item.description: A potentially serious rail accident was averted late on Tuesday after a Vande Bharat Express train came to an emergency stop on spotting an autorickshaw stranded on the tracks in Kerala’s Thiruvananthapuram district, railway officials said.

item.title: ISRO launches US BlueBird Block-2 satellite on LVM3 in commercial mission
item.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) on Wednesday successfully launched a next-generation US communications satellite, BlueBird Block-2, marking a key commercial mission for the country’s heaviest launch vehicle, LVM3.

item.title: Delhi air quality improves slightly, slips to ‘very poor’ from ‘severe’
item.description: Delhi’s air quality showed marginal improvement on Wednesday morning, with pollution levels easing from the ‘severe’ category recorded a day earlier, according to data from the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).

item.title: Bangladesh interim government to support family of Hindu worker lynched in Mymensingh
item.description: The Bangladesh interim government has said it will take responsibility for the welfare of the family of a Hindu garment factory worker who was lynched by a mob last week following allegations of blasphemy.

item.title: Goa nightclub fire: court grants bail to two of three arrested managers
item.description: A Goa court has granted bail to two managers of the ‘Birch by Romeo Lane’ nightclub who were arrested in connection with the fire that killed 25 people at the entertainment hotspot on 6 December

item.title: Pakistani-flag balloons recovered near LoC in north Kashmir
item.description: Security forces have recovered a series of balloons carrying Pakistani markings in areas close to the Line of Control (LoC) in north Kashmir, prompting heightened vigilance and surveillance, officials said on Wednesday.

item.title: West Bengal Assembly elections in 2026 likely to be held in fewer phases
item.description: The 2026 West Bengal Assembly elections are likely to be conducted in fewer phases compared to the previous two polls, according to sources from the office of the Chief Electoral Officer (CEO), West Bengal.

item.title: Supreme Court nod to Aravalli definition despite own panel’s objections
item.description: The Supreme Court’s acceptance of a new 100-metre definition for the Aravalli hill range has raised fresh questions about the process followed by the Union environment ministry and the potential ecological impact of the decision.

item.title: Gold and silver hit record highs amid geopolitical tensions and rate cut hopes
item.description: Gold and silver prices surged to record levels on Wednesday, driven by escalating tensions between the United States and Venezuela and expectations of further US interest rate cuts next year.
